---
title: Raw HTML tags
---

<script>HOSTILE_SCRIPT()</script>

<div onclick="HOSTILE_CLICK()" style="background:url(//evil.example/HOSTILE)">kept block text HOSTILE_BLOCK</div>

Inline <img src=x onerror=HOSTILE_ERROR()> and <b onmouseover="HOSTILE_OVER()">kept bold text</b> and <svg onload="HOSTILE_LOAD()"><circle r=1 /></svg> inside a paragraph.

<iframe src="https://evil.example/HOSTILE"></iframe>

<style>body { background: url(//evil.example/HOSTILE) }</style>

<a href="javascript:HOSTILE_HREF()">raw link text</a> <form action="https://evil.example/HOSTILE"><input name=x onfocus=HOSTILE_FOCUS() autofocus></form>

<object data="https://evil.example/HOSTILE"></object><embed src="https://evil.example/HOSTILE"><link rel=stylesheet href="https://evil.example/HOSTILE.css"><meta http-equiv=refresh content="0;url=https://evil.example/HOSTILE"><base href="https://evil.example/HOSTILE/">

<details open ontoggle=HOSTILE_TOGGLE()><summary>kept summary text</summary>x</details>

<math><mi xlink:href="javascript:HOSTILE_MATH()">x</mi></math>

<table><tr><td onclick="HOSTILE_TD()">cell</td></tr></table>

<video src="https://evil.example/HOSTILE.mp4" poster="https://evil.example/HOSTILE.png" autoplay onerror=HOSTILE_V()></video>
<audio src="https://evil.example/HOSTILE.mp3"></audio>
<img src="https://evil.example/HOSTILE.png">
